informational.text: ds-date-picker reads --ds-date-picker-max-width (default 100%) as the max-width of its host. A fullWidth date picker fills its container up to that width; without fullWidth the field stays as wide as its date format.
informational.verify: set --ds-date-picker-max-width on a fullWidth ds-date-picker in a wide container and confirm the field stops at that width with the calendar icon at its right edge, and that a date picker without fullWidth keeps its width.
